title: feat(post): add RichAuto DSP A11 3-axis router post (.mmg format)
body:
## What changed

- New post `assets/posts/richauto.cps` for the RichAuto DSP A11 router controller.
- The post is registered as `"RichAuto DSP A11"` in `BUILTINS` (`crates/app/src/posting_files.rs`). It comes after Mach4, before Mach3.
- The output follows the `.mmg` program that a Laguna Swift A11 runs (#1907, comment of 2026-11-18). The comment of 2026-11-18 on this issue names that program as the conformance target.
  - The file extension is `.mmg`.
  - Each block has a sequence number: `N10`, then steps of 10. Comment lines and the `%` line have no number.
  - There are no spaces between words.
  - Lengths have three decimals. `F` is mm/min with one decimal.
  - Rapid is `G00` and feed is `G1`. The spindle starts with `M03S<rpm>` and stops with `M05`.
  - An axis word or an `F` word that does not change is not written.
  - The program ends with `M30` and then a `%` line.
- The setup block is `G21G90G17`. The post writes no `G54`, `G40`, `G80`, `G91.1`, `G94`, `G43`, `G49`, `T` or `M6` word.
- Offset 1 is the work origin that the operator sets on the pendant. Offsets 2 and higher are refused by name.
- Arcs use incremental `I`/`J`/`K` (`AbsCntr = Off`). An arc of more than 180 degrees is split.
- Drilling cycles are expanded to plain `G00`/`G1` moves, with the floor dwell and the bore spindle stop and restart.
- The `SpindleDwellMs` option writes `G04P<ms>` after the spindle start. The default is 0.
- The post refuses these by name: tapping, `G41`/`G42`, probing, rotary moves, `G96`, a second tool, an inch document, a bad rpm, a bad coolant, and a missing or low clearance plane.
- The post writes header notes (#2996) and WARN records as `(...)` comments.

## Cause

The shipped posts do not run safely on an A11. They write `G91.1`, `G53`, `T.. M6`, `G43` and canned cycles. A basic A11 firmware can refuse these words.

## Tests

- `crates/post/tests/script_richauto.rs` and `crates/post/tests/richauto_safety/mod.rs`: 42 tests, including the 11 recorded-stream goldens of `post_suite!`.
- The pin `richauto_writes_the_a11_mmg_block_format` was red on the older held script (format without `N`, `%`): `the program ends with %`. It is green on the new script.
- On `upstream/main` all the pins are red, because the post does not exist.
- `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs`: RichAuto is added to `POSTS`, `REFUSED` (`tap_plate`, "tapping"), the synth stream (G54, no tap) and `EXTENSIONS` (`mmg`). All 7 tests pass.
- `crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs`: 22 text posts write both header notes. The native Agie dispatcher refuses them by name.
- Mutations. Each mutant was run against the pins, then the script was restored and the pins were green again:
  - no final `%` line: 8 tests red, including `richauto_writes_the_a11_mmg_block_format`;
  - spaces between words: 18 tests red;
  - no modal word omission: 11 tests red, including `unchanged_axis_and_feed_words_are_left_out`;
  - no `onComment` hook: `comment_escape::header_notes_use_each_shipped_dialect_and_keep_the_full_surface_bound` red;
  - no sequence step (all blocks `N0`): 7 tests red.
- The earlier coolant fix retains operation names in every coolant refusal. The pin is `richauto_safety::coolant_refusals_name_the_operation`.

## Author refresh and final-head verification

The refresh merges `upstream/main` at `35e3bd173d084c73c6fb3e6819a0247b7060dcb5`.
It keeps both RichAuto and Mach3 registry entries, embedded scripts, conformance cases and extensions.
It keeps the separate text-post and native-refusal counters and all comment assertions.
It also imports the upstream correction for `slot_dxf_outline.cl`, identified in #3293 through `f4b351682` and PR #3285.

Final head: `e276e36058733af7c0fae58bffaa8898bbb16922`.

The first quick run passed 794 of 795 steps on the earlier merge head.
The only failure was `app suites: mcp_setup_moves`. Its isolated repeat passed 0 of 1 steps.
That test still expected name order after undo, although upstream now uses creation order.
This refresh also imports upstream commit `1c6002baa313f0f31643acca790ea281fe929406` through PR #3603.
The upstream test now captures the setup list before deletion and checks both undo operations against that list.
Final verification on the new merge head passes as recorded below.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: **GREEN: 795 of 795 steps passed, 0 failed; 48.3 minutes**.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: **GREEN: 212 of 212 steps passed, 0 failed; 31.4 minutes**. Selected lanes: **app heavy: every target**.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: **passed: `cargo clippy -j24 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` (1 minute 6 seconds)**.
- Catalog and reached golden suites: **All passed in the final quick gate: `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `conformance`, `recorded_streams`, `solid_law_goldens` and `slot_dxf_sketch`**.
- Pin proof: **The old slot golden, the omitted RichAuto registry entry and the text-post count changed from 22 to 21 each made its pin fail (RED, exit 101). Restoring each fix made its pin pass (GREEN, exit 0)**. The slot pin is `slot_dxf_sketch::a_slot_outline_seeds_the_slot_and_cuts_it_to_size`.
- Registry pin: `conformance::every_builtin_registry_entry_compiles`.
- Extension pin: `conformance::every_builtin_declares_its_controls_file_extension`.
- Comment pin: `comment_escape::header_notes_use_each_shipped_dialect_and_keep_the_full_surface_bound`.
- No UI changes are in this fix round. Screenshots do not apply.

## Goldens moved

No existing PR golden changed relative to the current upstream base.
The refresh imports `crates/app/tests/golden/slot_dxf_outline.cl` from upstream.
That upstream fix generated the v2 record with 15 moves, replacing the stale v1 record with 9 moves.
This round does not regenerate that file locally because the upstream commit already supplies the generated correction.
**The final quick gate passed the catalog and reached golden suites. No golden file changed during the tests**.

The original RichAuto additions remain unchanged. These 24 files pin the new post and its refusals:

- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/richauto/contour_disc_hole.nc`.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/richauto/contour_plate_with_hole.nc`.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/richauto/contour_tangential_lead.nc`.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/richauto/drill_peck.nc`.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/richauto/drill_plate.nc`.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/richauto/face_square_40x40.nc`.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/richauto/face_square_40x40_stepped.nc`.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/richauto/pocket_waterline_plate_with_island.nc`.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/richauto/pocket_zigzag_plate_with_island.nc`.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/richauto/slot_fullwidth_centerline.nc`.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/richauto/slot_wide_channel_rows.nc`.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/richauto/trace_plate_with_hole.nc`.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/synth_richauto.nc`.
- `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/richauto/arcs.nc`.
- `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/richauto/css_then_live.refusal`.
- `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/richauto/drill_retract.nc`.
- `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/richauto/empty_section.nc`.
- `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/richauto/extreme_coords.nc`.
- `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/richauto/full_circle.nc`.
- `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/richauto/full_circle_raw.nc`.
- `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/richauto/live_then_stop.refusal`.
- `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/richauto/probe.refusal`.
- `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/richauto/rotary.refusal`.
- `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/richauto/tool_change.refusal`.

The arc centres are correct with a non-zero origin.

## Not exercised

- No program ran on an A11 or on the friend's Laguna Swift.
- The A11 response to `G21G90G17`, to `G2`/`G3` with incremental centres and to `G04P` is not confirmed. The sample program has no setup block, no arcs and no dwell.
- The sample program has CRLF line ends. This post writes LF.
- `axisInversion` is not declared. The engine refuses a machine with an inverted axis by name. Grbl 1.1 is the same.

## Overlaps

These open PRs add rows to the same lists (`BUILTINS`, or the lists in `conformance.rs`). They touch other posts and do not change the same function: #3160, #3058, #2999, #2993, #2992, #2981, #2979, #2978, #2974, #2972, #2969, #2968, #2964, #2955, #2951, #2646, #2515. The PR that merges second refreshes.

Changelog: New built-in post "RichAuto DSP A11" for RichAuto A11 routers (Laguna Swift, Grizzly): .mmg files with N numbers, one tool, drilling as plain moves, named refusals for tapping, cutter compensation and probing.

Fixes #1914
